components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 0.5rem); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--color-violet, #5835A5); color: #fff; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-violet-hover, #4A2C8C); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-violet, #5835A5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined control on paper surfaces for lower-pressure actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 0.5rem); border: 1px solid var(--color-divider, #DCD7CD); background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, #191817); font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-foreground, #191817) 28%, var(--color-divider, #DCD7CD)); background: color-mix(in srgb, white 70%, var(--color-background, #F6F3ED)); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-violet, #5835A5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-media-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 0.75fr); gap: 2rem; align-items: center; padding: 2rem; background: var(--color-violet-dark, #382263); color: var(--color-on-violet, #F6F3ED); } .ds-video { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 0.75rem); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #191817, #625F59); overflow: hidden; } .ds-play { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 4rem; height: 4rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-violet-dark, #382263); box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated, 0 4px 12px rgb(25 24 23 / 0.08), 0 16px 40px rgb(25 24 23 / 0.1)); } .ds-media-label { margin: 0; font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); } .ds-media-band h3 { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font: 600 1.75rem/1.2 "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; color: #fff; } .ds-media-band p:last-child { margin: 1rem 0 0; font: 400 1rem/1.65 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); }

narrative.overview:
The visual system treats the site as a premium personal-authority publication—closer to a respected author site or university lecture series than a startup marketing page or VC firm. Warm off-white paper, near-black type, restrained deep violet for action, and a whisper of warm gold for rare emphasis. Large editorial serif headlines carry gravitas; clean sans-serif UI keeps navigation and CTAs contemporary without trendiness.

Longevity and experience are advantages. Photography of John speaking or in conversation leads; decorative chrome never replaces content. Motion stays subtle; media never autoplays.
keyCharacteristics: Warm editorial paper field, not pure white SaaS canvas
Deep violet as the sole primary action color
Generous section spacing; thin dividers; restrained cards
Contact-first, low-pressure hierarchy; firm identity stays in the footer

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet owns interactive emphasis. Gold appears only as occasional editorial ornament—not competing CTAs.

rules.name: The No-Neon Rule
rules.body: No gradients-as-brand, glassmorphism, or heavy purple image overlays.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: A single page-level `<h1>`; section titles are `<h2>`.

rules.name: The Viewport Hero Rule
rules.body: Keep the hero messaging and primary CTA visible within roughly one desktop viewport—large type, not billboard-scale type.

dos: Do lead with John’s ideas, real talks, biography, writing, and founded companies.
Do use text labels for institutions when logos are unavailable or endorsement-sensitive.
Do keep John Chisholm Ventures quiet (footer/legal), not as the dominant logo.
Do use real People & Places photos and captions for social proof; never invent quotes or metrics.
donts: Don't present the site as an active VC fund, portfolio solicitation, or pitch portal.
Don't use carousels, autoplay video, scroll-jacking, startup gradients, or neon accents.
Don't wall the homepage with company logos or lead with an article archive.
Don't use “JCV” as the primary public identity on the homepage.
